# Log Show and Append Tests — verify log entry management

# --- Setup: initialize KB ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- Fresh KB shows no log entries ---

exec akb log show
! stdout .

# --- Append a log entry with title ---

exec akb log append ingest 'Ingested notes' --title 'Note One'

# --- Show log contains the entry ---

exec akb log show
stdout 'ingest'
stdout 'Note One'
stdout 'Ingested notes'

# --- Append another entry without title ---

exec akb log append delete 'Removed page'

exec akb log show
stdout 'delete'
stdout 'Removed page'

# --- Show last N entries ---

exec akb log show --last 1
stdout 'Removed page'
! stdout 'Note One'

# --- Filter by type ---

exec akb log show --type ingest
stdout 'Ingested notes'
! stdout 'Removed page'

# --- Filter by nonexistent type returns no output ---

exec akb log show --type nonexistent
! stdout .

# --- Invalid operation type is rejected ---

! exec akb log append invalid 'Bad operation'
stderr 'invalid operation'
stderr 'ingest, delete, update, lint, query'

# --- All valid operation types work ---

exec akb log append update 'Updated content'

exec akb log show --type update
stdout 'Updated content'

exec akb log append lint 'Linted files'

exec akb log show --type lint
stdout 'Linted files'

exec akb log append query 'Searched content'

exec akb log show --type query
stdout 'Searched content'

# --- Log entry with title renders title ---

exec akb log append ingest 'Another ingest' --title 'Title Entry'

exec akb log show --last 1
stdout 'Title Entry'

type: note

summary: Note for log testing
tags: test
---
Note content for log test.
